kb_proposals: An open subset W : Opens M of a (G,X)-manifold is a (G,X)-manifold with no extra work: GX.closedUnderRestriction_gxGroupoid (instance, in GX.Structure.Basic) feeds mathlib's TopologicalSpace.Opens.instHasGroupoid; the chart of W at x is (chartAt X x.1).subtypeRestr, so chartAt X x y = chartAt X x.1 y.1 by rfl (GX.chartAt_opens_apply).

For maps between open subsets, write the induced map as fun x : W => (⟨f x, h x x.2⟩ : V), not MapsTo.restrict / Set.codRestrict: those land in the subtype of (V : Set N), on which ChartedSpace X fails to synthesize.
